// diagnostic

E0753

A distinct type is used where another type is expected

What

A distinct type is used where another type is expected

Why

A distinct type is never accepted in place of its base type or another distinct type, even when both are built on the same base.

Fix

Convert explicitly with the distinct type's constructor, or compare the underlying values with `.raw()`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0753: tests/ui/distinct_constructor_alias.stderr.

Error [jet.DistinctTypeMismatch]: `UserID(value)` is not a distinct conversion
  --> tests/ui/distinct_constructor_alias.jet:4:9
    |
  4 |     id: UserID(1)
    |         ^^^^^^
 Why: Explicit conversions are owned by the destination type and name their source
 Fix: Write `UserID.from_int(value)`
